text:
Maya: First-run wizard is stuck asking me to login every time I open a new shell if my config dir is a symlink to ~/dotfiles. redwoodctl keeps prompting even after a successful auth.
Ryan: that sounds nasty. which redwoodctl version and how is the symlink set up?
Maya: macOS 13.6, redwoodctl 0.24.1 (homebrew). ~/.redwood -> ~/dotfiles/redwood (directory).
Sasha: do you get any errors in `~/.redwood/logs`?
Maya: no obvious errors, but when i run `redwoodctl auth whoami` right after login it returns my user, then next command returns 401 and asks to login again.
Ryan: can you paste the output of `ls -l ~/.redwood` and `stat ~/.redwood`?
Maya: ```
$ ls -l ~/.redwood
lrwxr-xr-x  1 maya  staff  20 Mar  5 10:02 /Users/maya/.redwood -> /Users/maya/dotfiles/redwood
$ stat -f "%N %Sp %Su" /Users/maya/dotfiles/redwood
/Users/maya/dotfiles/redwood drwxr-xr-x maya
```
Nora: looks like permissions are 755 on the target. The CLI uses an atomic write + rename to store the token file and has a check that refuses to follow symlinks in some cases. We added symlink-safe code for linux, might have regressed on darwin+homebrew.
Sasha: i can repro on my M1 with the same setup. the token store ends up being written to a temp file then the rename refuses due to a directory inode mismatch, so the token is never moved into place.
Maya: workarounds? i can’t move my dotfiles out of repo.
Ryan: short-term: set REDWOODCTL_CONFIG to the real path: `export REDWOODCTL_CONFIG="$HOME/dotfiles/redwood"` and run `redwoodctl auth login` once. CLI will write straight to that path and stop prompting.
Maya: verified that works, thanks.
Nora: filed internal bug DEVEX-5123, marking as P1 for next patch. devex-bot: please add labels `symlink`, `auth`, `darwin`.
devex-bot: Ticket DEVEX-5123 created by Nora: "redwoodctl login loop with symlinked config dir on macOS".
Sasha: i'll draft a small fix to prefer writing to the resolved target path (with a fallback) and add an integration test that uses symlinked dirs.
Maya: thanks! can we add a note to the onboarding docs about the env workaround? a few folks might hit this with dotfiles setups.
Nora: yes — i'll add a short blurb to the CLI troubleshooting docs and link the ticket. ETA for patch: next weekly patch (in ~4 days).
Ryan: we'll also add a CI test that runs homebrew-built binary on darwin with a symlinked config dir.
Maya: happy to test the beta once it's ready :thumbsup:
Sasha: thanks all, closing the loop for now.
